import asyncio
from oria.config import Settings
from oria.providers.apifootball.client import ApiFootballClient
from oria.providers.apifootball.mapper import map_fixtures, map_standings

async def test\(\):
    s = Settings\(\)
    client = ApiFootballClient\(settings=s\)
    await client.start\(\)
    try:
        # Derniers matchs Ligue 1 saison 2024
        raw = await client.fetch\(''/fixtures'', {''league'': ''61'', ''season'': ''2024'', ''last'': ''3''}\)
        fixtures = map_fixtures\(raw\)
        print\(f''=== {len\(fixtures\)} derniers matchs Ligue 1 2024 ===''\)
        for f in fixtures:
            status = f[''status''].get\(''short'', ''?''\)
            home = f[''home''][''name'']
            away = f[''away''][''name'']
            gh = f[''goals_home'']
            ga = f[''goals_away'']
            date = f[''date''][:10] if f[''date''] else ''?''
            print\(f''  {date} | {home} {gh}-{ga} {away} [{status}]''\)

        # Classement Ligue 1 2024
        raw2 = await client.fetch\(''/standings'', {''league'': ''61'', ''season'': ''2024''}\)
        standings = map_standings\(raw2\)
        print\(f''\\n=== Classement Ligue 1 2024 \(top 5\) ===''\)
        for entry in standings[:5]:
            rank = entry[''rank'']
            team = entry[''team''][''name'']
            pts = entry[''points'']
            gd = entry[''goals_diff'']
            print\(f''  {rank}. {team} -- {pts} pts \(diff: {gd:+d}\)''\)

        print\(f''\\nGovernor: {client.governor.calls_today} appels''\)
        print\(f''Budget restant: {client.governor.remaining_budget}''\)
    finally:
        await client.stop\(\)

asyncio.run\(test\(\)\)
")
